'Denke' is the ich-form of the present tense; 'denken an' means 'to think of/about something'.
'Glauben an' means 'to believe in'; also used informally to express opinion, similar to 'denken'.

Colloquial separable verb, informal variant of 'hinausgehen'; the prefix 'raus' separates in main clauses, e.g. 'Ich gehe raus'.

english: to go out; to run out
notes: Separable strong verb; means 'to go out socially' or 'to run out of something' (e.g. 'Das Licht geht aus' = the light goes out; 'Mir geht das Geld aus' = I'm running out of money).
